name: CSO_STG_CLICKTHROUGHS
description: This table is a temporary table needed for ETL. The table will contain only an hour or two worth of clickthrough data copied over from the svc_req_action_capture table.

columns.name: STG_CLICKTHROUGH_ID
columns.description: This column is the primary key for this table. It is an auto-generated number.

columns.name: ANSWER_ID
columns.description: This is the answerId of the corresponding answer that was clicked on.

columns.name: CLICKTHROUGH_POSITION
columns.description: The sum of positions of each answer clicked against a question.

columns.name: REQUEST_DATE
columns.description: The date the request occurred for the clickthrough.

columns.name: SEARCH_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: The Search Transaction ID is associated with a particular question. The Search Transaction ID helps to identify the question that is associated with the clickthrough.

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE
columns.description: Whether the clickthrough is associated with a document, an attachment or external content.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SESSION_ID
columns.description: Knowledge Interaction ID or session ID associated with a question.
